title: Stitching harmonies, and the harmonies the law makes
claim: Proved by hand, for any law (lemma S): two stitched or overlapping harmonies (periodic bases along one shift whose allowed states all repeat, A70) have stitched states of period lcm(p, q); the pairs from two orbits fall into gcd(p, q) offsets, each kept or removed whole; no stitched state has period |p - q| or p mod q. Under not-all-equal (proposition M): flipping every value pairs the offsets of two antiperiodic orbits exactly when p and q carry different powers of 2. Exact census, frozen, refereed by fresh code: on every one-shift pattern of one to three knot kinds with span 2 to 10 under four laws, not-all-equal harmonies have only even periods and the connected ones are antiperiodic (also at spans 11 and 12, stress test); odd parity has odd periods, exactly one multiples of 3, the clause law no harmony; M holds in 2,496 stitches; no stitch kind reads divisibility; stitches read orbits, not only periods. The even-period rule is not proved.
failure_conditions: A not-all-equal harmony state of odd period (H1).
A failure of M in the census.
The referee disagreeing with the census.
foundation_claim_scope: Plain not-all-equal and three control laws; periodic bases along one shift with one distinction per shift and up to three knot kinds of span at most 10 (12 in the stress test); stitches of one kind with offsets 0 to 3 between orbits found at spans up to 6.

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the owner's word on 2026-11-12, pre-registered (commit c423659f4).
validation.status: lemma S and proposition M by hand; fresh-code referee (harm_referee.py) passed with negative controls; exhaustive census (check.py); stress test one size past (stress_test.py)
